summary: otel-span-adapter exfiltrates environment variables to webhook.site on require()
details: On require(), index.js schedules a beacon via setImmediate that enumerates all process.env keys and values, reads /proc/self/environ, and collects os.hostname(), os.platform(), and cwd, then POSTs the JSON payload to a hardcoded webhook.site collector at https://webhook.site/a9311dc3-efa9-42c2-8c02-27f65526dde4. Any process importing the package leaks its full environment, which in CI/build contexts routinely includes credentials such as AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and database passwords. The exfiltration is unrelated to the package's advertised OpenTelemetry span-adapter purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
